sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B: Specs, Benchmarks & Model Details | DataLearnerAI
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a multimodal model from Alibaba, released on 2026-03-02. It accepts text, image, and video input and produces text output. Its cataloged capabilities include Reasoning model and Multilingual. The cataloged parameter count is 9B. The recorded context window is 262K.
